title: データ可視化コンセプト
description: 数字や文字を使わず、光る立体グラフと透明パネルでデータの増減を表す抽象ビジュアルです。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 青紫の発光体による低照度の面光源
tone.framing: 中央に主題を置いた奥行きのある16:9
tone.texture: 透明ガラス、発光する立体、微細な粒子

pieces.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: KAKERA stock B-roll for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: ascending translucent bars arranged like a chart without labels or numbers
Scene/backdrop: an abstract dark presentation space with floating data forms, no interface text
Style/medium: polished cinematic 3D visualization with realistic glass and soft volumetric light
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 frame, layered depth, clear central subject and negative space
Lighting/mood: controlled blue and violet glow on a dark background
Color palette: navy, black, cyan, restrained violet
Materials/textures: transparent glass panels, luminous bars, matte floor, soft particles
Constraints: no people, no faces, no readable text, no logos, no brands, no watermark, no UI overlays, no recognizable trademarks
